text_block_list.text: —The day before the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby has arrived once more this year,
and the venue is buzzing with incredible excitement!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will be the luckiest Umamusume
to claim the second crown of the Classic Triple Crown?!
Now, the start is just moments away—
(Click!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!?
Why did you turn it off—

I take the well-worn disc out of the player.
To think they've been watching it until this hour,
even though the Japan Derby is tomorrow...
choice_data_list: I told you to go home early and get some rest today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Th-That's, well...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“...Because it's tomorrow, I just can't settle down.
Thinking about how if as many people come to watch this year,
that's how huge of a crowd will be looking at me...”

Apparently, she's quite nervous.
It's the eve of the once-in-a-lifetime Nippon Derby,
so it's only natural, but still...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
C-Could I please not take
just one more look...?

Could I somehow encourage her...?
An idea suddenly strikes me, and I pull a notebook out of my bag.
choice_data_list: Rob Roy, take a look at this

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, the 'Heroic Tale'...

"The Tale of Zenno Rob Roy's Heroism"—
A diary, a record, and the one and only story in the world that the two of them had been writing together since before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...What will you write? Um...
"Zenno Rob Roy was"—
"Zenno Rob Roy kicks up the turf with immense power, charting an unwavering course fit for a true hero. None can hope to catch her."
"And... crowned with glory, she will obtain a sword of her own, one that rivals even her idol, the hero Rob Roy."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Y-You wrote something incredible.
It's like I'm invincible in this story...
choice_data_list: You'll be invincible in real life too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Because I've already written it into the "Epic Tale"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. I did write it down, after all...
...Then I really have to do it, don't I?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
That gave me a little bit of courage.
choice_data_list: Shall we head home properly and prepare for tomorrow, then?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'm sorry, I'll do that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Um... there's just one place I'd like to stop by.
Would you mind taking a small detour...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Rob Roy.
—What is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to interrupt your training.
Um... E-Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If...!
If it's alright with you, that is...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Tomorrow's Nippon Derby!!
Won't you... come watch me race in it...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san. I...
I truly admire you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You are.
You are—truly like a hero.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —A “Hero.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You... gave me courage.
Just by seeing you. By watching you run.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To a way of being... sharp and straightforward, like a sword.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The courage you gave me guided my way.
Like St. Elmo's fire shining through a thunderstorm.
Unwavering—and straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... gh, that's why, so,
I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
At the Nippon Derby... I will absolutely deliver results.
And with that, I fully intend to seize it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The qualifications of a hero. My very own... sword.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I was hoping that…… Kris S-san.
You would be there to witness it――"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, n-no, I won't force you!
Only... only if your schedule permits, of course...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—There is training tomorrow as well.
I cannot make—any guarantees.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine!
Just knowing you'd consider it is more than enough...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um.
...I'll do my best, okay?"
And finally, the day of the Nippon Derby arrived—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—Here it is once again, the Nippon Derby! The excitement in the venue is electric!!”
(WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Even from all the way back here, the cheers are incredible...!
So this is the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(A scenery completely different from what I saw
on screen, or even from the stands...
is surely waiting just past this path.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...I glanced at the stands a moment ago, but... Kris S-san wasn't there.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Maybe they're just hidden in the crowd, or maybe they were too busy to make it after all.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it's okay. I'm okay.
"Zenno Rob Roy kicks up the turf with immense power, charting an unwavering course fit for a true hero. None can hope to catch her."
"And... crowned with glory, she will obtain a sword of her own, one that rivals even her idol, the hero Rob Roy."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Right. I—cannot afford to be
shaken by something of this scale.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ("Kick off the turf with all your might." "Stay true to your unbending path"—Go!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I'm going to become
an 'unwavering hero,' just like her!"
